name: disk-guard
description: Warns when the disk is nearly full before builds, installs and docker pulls.

minFreeGb.title: Minimum free space (GB)
minFreeGb.description: Warn before a heavy command when the disk has less than this many gigabytes free.

maxUsedPercent.title: Maximum used (%)
maxUsedPercent.description: Warn when the disk is fuller than this, however much is free. 100 turns this check off.
